questions.text: A particle is moving with velocity v = 2t² + 3t. Find its acceleration at t = 2s.
A convex lens has focal length 20 cm. At what distance from the lens should an object be placed to get a real image twice the size of object?
questions.solution: Magnification m = -2 (real image). m = v/u = -2 → v = -2u. Lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. 1/20 = 1/(-2u) - 1/u = -3/(2u). u = -30 cm. So object distance = 30 cm.

questions.text: The escape velocity of a body from Earth is 11.2 km/s. What is the escape velocity from a planet having mass 4 times and radius twice that of Earth?
A wire of resistance R is stretched to double its length. New resistance will be:
questions.solution: When length is doubled (L' = 2L), cross-sectional area halves (A' = A/2). R' = ρL'/A' = ρ(2L)/(A/2) = 4ρL/A = 4R.

questions.text: The de Broglie wavelength of an electron moving with velocity v is λ. If velocity is doubled, wavelength becomes:
questions.solution: λ = h/p = h/(mv). If v doubles, λ' = h/(m·2v) = λ/2.

questions.text: The IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)COOH is:
questions.solution: Longest chain has 4 C with COOH at C1 and methyl at C2 → 2-Methylbutanoic acid.

questions.text: How many moles of O₂ are required for complete combustion of 1 mole of C₄H₁₀?
questions.solution: C₄H₁₀ + 6.5O₂ → 4CO₂ + 5H₂O. So 6.5 moles of O₂ are needed.

questions.text: Which of the following shows +R effect?
questions.solution: -OH, -NH₂, -OR show +R (resonance) effect as they donate electrons. -NO₂, -CN, -COOH show -R effect.

questions.text: The pH of 10⁻³ M HCl solution is:
The coordination number in NaCl crystal structure is:
questions.solution: NaCl has face-centered cubic (FCC) structure with each Na⁺ surrounded by 6 Cl⁻ and vice versa.

questions.text: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {2, 3, 4}, find A ∩ B.
questions.solution: A ∩ B = elements common to both sets = {2, 3}.

questions.text: Find the derivative of f(x) = sin(x²).
questions.solution: Using chain rule: d/dx[sin(x²)] = cos(x²) · d/dx(x²) = 2x cos(x²).

questions.text: The value of ∫₀¹ x² dx is:
If the probability of an event A is 0.4 and of B is 0.5, and A and B are independent, then P(A ∩ B) is:
questions.solution: For independent events: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B) = 0.4 × 0.5 = 0.2.

questions.text: The equation of line with slope 2 passing through (1, 3) is:
questions.solution: Point-slope form: y - 3 = 2(x - 1) → y = 2x + 1.

questions.text: A capacitor of 10 µF is charged to 100 V. The energy stored is:
The equivalent resistance of three 6 Ω resistors connected in parallel is:
The photon energy of light with wavelength 500 nm is (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ Js):
In SHM, the acceleration is maximum at:
questions.solution: a = -ω²x. Acceleration is maximum at extreme positions (x = ±A) and zero at mean position.

questions.text: First law of thermodynamics is based on:
questions.solution: ΔU = Q - W. First law is the law of conservation of energy for thermodynamic systems.

questions.text: Which of the following is an aromatic compound?
questions.solution: Benzene follows Hückel's rule (4n+2 π electrons, n=1) and is planar with delocalized electrons.

questions.text: The oxidation state of Mn in KMnO₄ is:
Which gas is known as "Laughing Gas"?
questions.solution: Nitrous oxide (N₂O) is called laughing gas due to its euphoric effects when inhaled.

questions.text: Shape of water molecule is:
questions.solution: Water has 2 bond pairs + 2 lone pairs → bent shape with ~104.5° bond angle.

questions.text: Which element has the highest ionization energy?
questions.solution: Helium has the highest ionization energy due to its full 1s² configuration and small atomic size.

questions.text: The sum of first 10 natural numbers is:
If sin θ = 3/5, then cos θ is:
questions.solution: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 → cos²θ = 1 - 9/25 = 16/25 → cos θ = 4/5 (θ in first quadrant).

questions.text: The arithmetic mean of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 is:
The roots of equation x² - 5x + 6 = 0 are:
The value of log₂ 32 is:
questions.solution: log₂ 32 = log₂ 2⁵ = 5.

questions.text: A car accelerates uniformly from rest to 20 m/s in 10 s. The acceleration is:
The magnetic field inside a solenoid is:
questions.solution: B = μ₀nI inside a long solenoid — uniform field.

questions.text: A body is projected vertically upward with velocity 20 m/s. Maximum height reached is (g=10 m/s²):
Which of the following has the highest penetrating power?
questions.solution: Gamma rays have the highest penetrating power due to their high energy and no charge.

questions.text: The efficiency of a Carnot engine operating between 500 K and 300 K is:
The unit of electric current in SI is:
questions.solution: Electric current is measured in Amperes (A).

questions.text: Two resistors 4 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in series. The total resistance is:
The momentum of a photon of energy E is:
questions.solution: p = E/c for a photon (since E = pc).

questions.text: The temperature at which Celsius and Fahrenheit scales read the same is:
Young's modulus is defined for which type of deformation?
questions.solution: Y = stress/strain for longitudinal (tensile/compressive) deformation.

questions.text: Which of the following is a Lewis acid?
questions.solution: AlCl₃ is electron deficient (can accept electron pair), hence a Lewis acid.

questions.text: The number of moles in 18 g of H₂O is:
questions.solution: Molar mass of H₂O = 18 g/mol. n = 18/18 = 1 mol.

questions.text: Which of these is NOT a greenhouse gas?
questions.solution: Oxygen (O₂) is not a greenhouse gas. CO₂, CH₄, and H₂O vapor are GHGs.

questions.text: The hybridization of carbon in methane is:
questions.solution: CH₄ has 4 bond pairs + 0 lone pairs → sp³ hybridization, tetrahedral shape.

questions.text: The most abundant element in Earth's crust is:
questions.solution: Oxygen (~46.6%) is the most abundant element in Earth's crust.

questions.text: Which bond has the highest bond energy?
questions.solution: Triple bond (C≡C) has highest bond energy — 839 kJ/mol vs 614 for double, 348 for single.

questions.text: The color of phenolphthalein in basic medium is:
questions.solution: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acid and pink in base (pH > 8.3).

questions.text: The number of isomeric pentanes (C₅H₁₂) possible is:
questions.solution: Pentane has 3 isomers: n-pentane, isopentane, neopentane.

questions.text: Which metal does not react with dilute HCl?
questions.solution: Copper is below hydrogen in reactivity series, so does not react with dilute HCl.

questions.text: The functional group in alcohol is:
questions.solution: Alcohols contain the hydroxyl (-OH) functional group.

questions.text: If f(x) = 2x + 1, find f(3):
The slope of line passing through (1,2) and (3,6) is:
The value of log₁₀ 1000 is:
questions.solution: log₁₀ 1000 = log₁₀ 10³ = 3.

questions.text: The sum of angles in a triangle is:
questions.solution: Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°.

questions.text: The median of 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 is:
questions.solution: Middle value of sorted 5 numbers = 5.

questions.text: The quadratic equation whose roots are 1 and 2 is:
questions.solution: Sum = 3, Product = 2 → x² - 3x + 2 = 0.

The value of 5! is:

If the distance between two charges is halved, the force between them becomes:
questions.solution: F ∝ 1/r². If r → r/2, F → 4F.

questions.text: SI unit of resistance is:
questions.solution: Resistance is measured in Ohms (Ω).

questions.text: Hooke's law relates stress and:
questions.solution: Within elastic limit, stress ∝ strain (Hooke's law).

questions.text: The Doppler effect in sound is observed when there is relative motion between source and:
questions.solution: Doppler effect occurs when source or observer is in motion relative to each other.

questions.text: The SI unit of magnetic flux is:
questions.solution: Magnetic flux is measured in Webers (Wb).

questions.text: A body of mass 1 kg has weight approximately:
questions.solution: W = mg = 1 × 10 = 10 N (approx).

questions.text: The phenomenon of splitting of white light into its components is called:
questions.solution: Dispersion is the splitting of white light into its constituent colors (VIBGYOR).

questions.text: Transformer works on the principle of:
questions.solution: Transformer works on electromagnetic induction via mutual induction between coils.

questions.text: The speed of sound is maximum in:
questions.solution: Sound travels fastest in solids (steel ~5000 m/s) due to close molecular arrangement.

questions.text: Atomic number of oxygen is:
questions.solution: Oxygen has atomic number 8 (configuration 1s²2s²2p⁴).

questions.text: Which of the following is a strong acid?
questions.solution: HCl completely dissociates in water → strong acid.

questions.text: The gas used in welding is:
questions.solution: Acetylene (C₂H₂) produces high temperature flame used in oxy-acetylene welding.

questions.text: The molar mass of CaCO₃ is:
Which of the following elements is liquid at room temperature?
questions.solution: Mercury (Hg) and bromine (Br₂) are the only elements liquid at room temp.

questions.text: The chemical name of common salt is:
questions.solution: Common salt is NaCl — Sodium chloride.

questions.text: The number of valence electrons in carbon is:
questions.solution: Carbon (Z=6) has electronic configuration 2,4 → 4 valence electrons.

questions.text: Which process is used to separate crude oil into useful fractions?
questions.solution: Fractional distillation separates petroleum into fractions based on boiling points.

questions.text: The pH of 0.001 M NaOH is approximately:
Which of these is a noble gas?
questions.solution: Xenon (Xe) is a noble gas. Cl₂, N₂, O₂ are diatomic gases.

questions.text: The number of ways to arrange letters of word CAT is:
questions.solution: 3! = 6 ways (CAT, CTA, ACT, ATC, TCA, TAC).

questions.text: The value of sin²30° + cos²30° is:
questions.solution: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 (identity).

questions.text: The nth term of AP: 2, 5, 8, 11... is:
The solution of 2x + 3 = 7 is:
Which of these is a perfect square?
questions.solution: 36 = 6². Others are not perfect squares.

questions.text: The mode of 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4 is:
questions.solution: 3 appears 3 times (highest frequency).

questions.text: The probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed is:
questions.solution: P(Head) = 1/2 (favorable outcomes / total outcomes).

questions.text: The value of i² (where i = √-1) is:
questions.solution: i² = -1 (fundamental property of imaginary numbers).

questions.text: The range of the function f(x) = x² is:
questions.solution: x² ≥ 0 for all real x → range [0, ∞).
